kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: The best games of 2026 so far, picked by NPR's staff

wire.title: India's youth-led Cockroach movement vows to continue protest after police crackdown
wire.summary: The movement, which began as a satirical protest, has evolved into a nationwide challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.

wire.title: Iran-backed Houthis announce blockade. And, Cyclospora source remains unknown
wire.summary: Iran-backed Houthis say they will blockade a waterway on the Red Sea. And, the FDA continues to investigate Taylor Farms lettuce as a source of the Cyclospora outbreak despite a retracted test.

wire.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods
wire.summary: President Donald Trump on Monday imposed 50% tariffs on most Canadian goods, declaring that Canada has unfairly discriminated against American autos, alcohol and dairy products.

wire.title: The best economic ideas from around the world — Planet Money Summer School is back

wire.title: How soccer brings a Bhutanese community together in Harrisburg, Pa.
wire.summary: Harrisburg is home to one of the nation's largest communities of Nepali-speaking Bhutanese refugees and their families. Through soccer, generations have found connection, belonging and a way to carry forward a shared history.

wire.title: Amid U.S.-Iran war, Houthi rebels threaten to blockade another key strait
wire.summary: The Houthis, a Shia militia in Yemen that's aligned with Iran, have announced a naval blockade of a key waterway, the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

wire.title: Amid nurse shortage, a university rolls out the welcome mat for men
wire.summary: Only about 1 in 8 nurses are men, but their share is growing. A strong job market for nurses and sustained efforts to recruit men into the field have made a difference, including in the South.

wire.title: A homeless man was charged with a felony for camping. He's one of the first
wire.summary: When Joseph Lamont Williams refused to leave the public park where he has lived for years, he was charged with a felony. Camping bans are on the rise as states seek to crack down on homelessness.

wire.title: Arizona primaries set the stage for contested fall races in a swing state
wire.summary: Arizona Democrats choose who can try to flip a Republican-held House seat, and Republicans pick their nominee to try to unseat a Democratic governor.

wire.title: Trump slaps 50% tariffs on Canada and Carney vows to 'intensify' trade talks
wire.summary: The duties mark a major escalation in trade tensions between the North American neighbours.

wire.title: Row escalates in Ukraine over army chief's future
wire.summary: Protesters are demanding Oleksandr Syrskyi be removed and former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov reinstated by Friday.

wire.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
wire.summary: Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.

wire.title: Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal
wire.summary: A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.

wire.summary: Firas al-Masri, his wife and their four children died in one attack, which the Israeli military says targeted a Hamas operative.
